'''Joan Besoli Lluelles''' (born 17 September 1959) is an [[Andorra]]n [[trap shooter]] who competed in the [[1992 Summer Olympics]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Joan Besoli|url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/be/joan-besoli-1.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200418120515/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/be/joan-besoli-1.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=18 April 2020|website=Olympics at Sports-Reference.com|accessdate=26 November 2017}}</ref>

Besoli competed in the [[Shooting at the 1992 Summer Olympics – Trap|mixed trap]] shooting event at the [[1992 Summer Olympics]] and scored 140 hits in the qualification round, finishing in joint 29th place and failing to qualify for the semi-finals.<ref>{{cite web|title=Shooting at the 1992 Barcelona Summer Games: Mixed Trap|url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/summer/1992/SHO/mixed-trap.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200418124616/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/summer/1992/SHO/mixed-trap.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=18 April 2020|website=Olympics at Sports-Reference.com|accessdate=26 November 2017}}</ref>
